title: Seed packet swap list
summary: Which seed packets are spare and which are wanted, for the swap table in spring.

# Seed packet swap list

Spare packets this year are dwarf marigolds, two kinds of lettuce and a long
row of radish. Wanted in return are climbing nasturtiums, a late carrot and
anything that does well in the shady strip by the fence. Packets with less
than half their seed left stay home, and anyone bringing a swap should label
each packet with the year it was bought.
